summary: A realtime 1v1 against u6bkep (lobby skill 30), Armada against Armada on Comet Catcher, won at 19:37 when group_G killed his commander beside his forward plants at C4. The economy decided it: 21 extractors at 8:00 (pool p75 18) and 34 from 16:00, a light turret at each outer spot and one extractor lost all game, against at most 22 of his ever seen. The army took ten minutes to convert that lead: the raid traded evenly at his C1 turret (5:14-6:50), then the body gathered in our half until 9:29 while he put up a forward plant at C4 (seen 7:30) and turned to Stouts and Janus. At D3 our reinforcements reached the grind in pieces, and we lost 9.8k for 7.3k of his from 9:29 to 14:18. His Stout block and commander broke on our turrets at spot_23 by 15:11, the trade turned our way (16:20-19:06: 7.0k lost for 9.6k), and the 40-unit body reached his commander. Nobody said anything in chat beyond our two banners.

root.what: After the raid's even Blitz trade at his C1 turret, the player pulled the body back to hold and gather at spot_1 in our half ('does not go west of spot_1') until it had about six Stouts. We had income 32 and estimated his at half that. Apart from the 8:12 chase, the body stayed in our half until 9:29. In that window he built the C4 forward plant and turned to Stouts and Janus, so our 2-3x economy then met an army of equal weight in the middle for ten minutes. This is my reading. The commander (a model) argued the same at 7:50.

their_play: Armada vehicles all game, and no air. Blitzes came from the start, first seen 2:46 near his plant. He had about 5 extractors at 2:59 (the player's read) and light turrets at his outer spots, rebuilding the one at spot_4 (C1) after we killed it at 5:19. He met our raid at that turret with Blitzes, and the trades were even from 5:14 to 8:45. His forward vehicle plant at C4 (spot_39) was seen at 7:30 with his first Stouts. Beamers (laser turrets) appeared at B8 (8:27), C1 (12:40), C5 (13:46) and C/D7 (15:06), and Janus from 9:57. For ten minutes he held the middle at D3 and C3 with a Stout and Janus block, his commander fighting in it: at 13:07 the party was his commander, 13 Stouts, a Janus and 2 Blitzes. He added two construction turrets at C4 (13:44) and a third vehicle plant at C4 (17:32). His tier 2 was never seen being built; the first signs were a Consul at 16:17, an advanced constructor at 16:25 and a moho at 18:36. By unique id we saw 77 Stouts, 28 Janus and 32 Blitzes, about 27.5k of soldiers, which is a far bigger economy than the 'three to one' the player assumed. He raided little: one extractor of ours died, spot_21 at 13:45 to Stouts. He did not chat.

the economic lead was not pressed from 6:31 to 9:29 (a gather in our half); the commander (a model) said so at 7:50. The seen army lead was small (1806 vs ~1545 at 7:50), so this is an economy lead, not the 400% army lead of the lesson

lens.caveats: There is no truth file, so his numbers are sightings and floors: the ratios in minutes.py (up to 23.6x) count only what we saw. There is no review.md, but the match directory holds two model reviews (impedance-review.md, unfinished-review.md); I read both and build on the impedance one, re-checking its claims where I cite them. pro_baseline has no carded side for G1, so the --all-starts pool (41 sides) is the baseline, and its four pressure rows printed '-'; I took the crossing clocks from minutes.py and the record. There is no ledger row; the label human-30 also names the later 4-seat game 1791748300. Neither a person nor the user wrote in chat. commander_turns reads only the player's transcript, so the commander's directions were read from commander.jsonl directly. The player session was replaced at 11:12. The root is my reading; a model (the commander) agrees, but no person does.

open_questions: When did he start the C4 forward plant and the Stout switch: before or after our 6:31 pullback? Both were first seen at 7:30, and there is no truth file.
What was his real economy? We saw at most 22 of his extractors, yet at least 27.5k of soldiers by unique id, so was 'three to one' ever true?
Would a gathering place in his half (C2/C3) from 6:31 have beaten his Stouts before the Janus came, or was holding right after the even Blitz trade at C1?
Where was his advanced vehicle plant and when was it started? The advanced constructor was first seen at 16:25 at C4, and the plant itself never.
Did the player session replacement at 11:12 cost anything in the D3 grind?
